raw_output: When the bus is late and you have already read all the news on your phone, it is nice to be able to pull out a good book. With the Derplera e-reader from Nelvex, you have all your books in one place, ready for both short breaks and long, lazy Sundays. Download your next book wirelessly and continue reading where you left off, whether you are on your way to work or have snuggled down under the covers. Try the different modes for the display lighting and choose the one that feels most comfortable at the time. You can also make the text larger when your eyes start to get tired. The e-reader is rechargeable, so you do not need to replace the batteries when the power runs out. When it is time to charge it, insert the charger's plug into the e-reader. If you want to protect the display from keys and other items in your bag, a case is a practical accessory. You will find information about what is included on the product's packaging, and you can read about the warranty in the terms and conditions of purchase. Then all that remains is to choose what you want to read next.
